source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 5 June 1964, p. 2 ("Taylor-Nobbs' success: Castlereagh")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: The Castlereagh results report read in the Belfast News-Letter of 5 June 1964; Dundonald and Gilnahirk counts from the returning officer's notice in the Belfast Telegraph of 11 June 1964.

note: Triennial election of Castlereagh Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Seven of the nine divisions were contested, Craigavad and Holywood returning unopposed. The counts for Dundonald and Gilnahirk are not printed in the report read and those divisions are omitted. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
